text.ms:
1. Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Suri Rumah (Perbekalan) 2023.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2023

2. Pengeluaran sejumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tujuh juta lapan ratus

dua puluh lima ribu ringgit (RM7,825,000) daripada Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan

Sosial Suri Rumah bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Skim Keselamatan Sosial

Suri Rumah bagi tahun 2023 adalah dengan ini dibenarkan bagi maksud yang dinyatakan

dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Amaun

(RM)

Emolumen 635,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan 730,000

Perbelanjaan lain 500,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan 5,960,000

JUMLAH 7,825,000

Dibuat 30 Julai 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(3); PN(PU2)765/JLD. 2]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Menteri Sumber Manusia

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 2022

HOUSEWIVES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2023

IN excercise of the powers conferred by subsection 54(1)

of the Housewives' Social Security Act 2022 [Act 838], the Minister makes

the following regulations:

Citation

1. These regulations may be cited as the Housewives' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2023.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2023

2. The issue of a sum not exceeding seven million eight hundred

and twenty-five thousand ringgit (RM7,825,000) from the Housewives' Social Security

Fund for the expenditure on administration of the Housewives' Social Security Scheme

for the year 2023 is hereby authorized for the purposes specified in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Amount

(RM)

Emoluments 635,000

Supplies and services 730,000

Other expenditures 500,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment 5,960,000

TOTAL 7,825,000

Made 30 July 2023

[KSM/PUU(S)600-1/1/31/7(3); PN(PU2)765/JLD. 2]

 SIVAKUMAR A/L VARATHARAJU NAIDU

Minister of Human Resources
